text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sev2 - GPU OOMs + node-flap detected in prod-eu-1 (paged-kv allocator). Auto-escalating to on-call.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing repeated container restarts on gpu-prod-eu-1-node-12 and node-13, logs show CUDA OOMs. Spike started ~00:10 UTC.

runtime-lead: Copy. Initial hypothesis: gradual KV cache fragmentation + paged-attention allocator creep -> slow memory exhaustion.

alice: quick log snippet: 
```
E CudaAllocator: failed to allocate 512MB: out of memory
W KVPager: free_pages=120 -> 0 over 30m, fragments=78%
```

infra: node-12 mem 95%, node-13 mem 93%, other nodes elevated. There's also a container crashloop with exit code 137 on node-13.

sre-oncall: I tried a restart on node-12, container came up but OOMs resumed after ~5m. This looks like slow leak not a one-off spike.

runtime-lead: mitigation plan (short): 1) cordon/drain affected nodes 2) route traffic to smaller-model fallback with lower KV footprint 3) enable aggressive KV compaction and reduce prefetch.

support: customer-impact: increased 429/504 in EU region, some latency spikes. Ops has reached out to top 3 customers in the region, no escalations yet.

alice: cordoning node-12 now and draining in background. Command: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-prod-eu-1-node-12
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpu-prod-eu-1-node-12
```

infra: cordon + drain confirmed for node-12. Starting slabinfo + nvml captures to /var/log/kvfrag-1819992222.log.

sre-oncall: traffic shifted off node-12, monitoring. Node-13 still flapping, holding off restart until we enable fallback.

runtime-lead: enabling fallback model variant for the pool (smaller KV working set) and setting envs: REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0, KV_COMPACT_INTERVAL=60s. Applying now.

infra: applied envs to pool, rolling update in progress.

support: visible error rate decreasing after routing change, still watching. 

sre-oncall: will keep on-call for 2h and collect traces. If OOMs persist after compaction settings we escalate to eng-runtime for allocator deep-dive.

incident-bot: Runbook note attached: "KV fragmentation live-mitigation checklist".

runtime-lead: follow-ups: collect heap profiles, enable kv diagnostic dump, consider hotfix to allocator free-path. I'll schedule a postmortem if we hit >30m repeat OOMs. :eyes:

support: continuing customer comms. tagging once we have final status.

sre-oncall: thanks — handoff complete. Will update thread with final state. :thumbsup:
